claims.hypothesis: mm continuum is from opaque hot dust
claims.experiment: Compare Q, B3, B6 continuum; SED fit

evidence.quote: We suggest that the 3 to 0.8 mm continuum emerges from hot dust with radius $r$=8 pc and temperature $T_{\rm d} \simeq$280 K.
